pages.en:
The dagger that severs contracts.

A Noble Phantasm that returns all magecraft effects to their original state and breaks the contract with a Servant.

It takes not Sakura's life, but only violates and destroys the contract that bound her.

A contract-breaker.
A Noble Phantasm that nullifies all magic and negates the contract with a Servant.
Without taking Sakura’s life, it destroys the contract that bound her.

影から解放された反動か、今は眠るように横たわっている。

Sakura is alive.

Perhaps from the shock of being released from the shadow, she now lies as though asleep.

Tohsaka——there is still time for Tohsaka too.

The bleeding has stopped. She possesses a proper Magic Crest.

That Crest is the crystallization of all the magecraft the Tohsaka family has left behind. Even with Tohsaka unconscious, it will not lightly allow its heir to die.

TohsakaTohsaka will make it too.

The Crest is the crystallization of the Tohsaka family’s magic. It won’t let their successor die even if she’s unconscious.

pages.en:
…Damn it.

Even deprived of Sakura, the vessel through which it acted, the black shadow will not disappear.

It has grown too far.

The shadow can now emerge without her.

So long as the Greater Grail exists, sooner or later it will crawl out under its own power.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Damn.
Even after losing its host, the black shadow hasn’t disappeared.
It has grown too large.
It can come out without Sakura’s help.
It will emerge so long as the Great Holy Grail still exists.

壊す。
あの影ごと、この巨大な魔法陣を切り崩す。
アンリマユの胎動は、大空洞を少しずつ崩壊させている。
……だが、この洞穴が崩れたところでアレが消え去るとは思えない。
アレはこの場で、跡形もなく消し去らなければならないものだ。

——Destroy it.

Tear this enormous magic circle apart together with the shadow.

Angra Mainyu's quickening is slowly bringing the great cavern down.

…But the collapse of this cave will not erase that thing.

It must be annihilated here without leaving a trace.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’ll destroy it.
I’ll destroy the giant magic circle, and the shadow along with it.
Angra Mainyu’s fetal activity is slowly destroying the cavern.
…But I don’t think it’ll die even if the cavern collapses.
I have to destroy that thing here and now.

As long as Angra Mainyu remains inside that black flame, it cannot move.

Cut it in two now, before it emerges, and drive it back into the “nothing” it once was.

If anything can accomplish that——

I will sweep the monster away with the mightiest Noble Phantasm I know.

“And what will you do?”
